Risks?

Cross-references all data sources to surface actionable security and correctness risks.

Untested hot paths
Functions with high hit counts but surviving mutants — code that runs a lot but isn't verified.
CT failures
DudeCT or Tacet tests detecting timing leaks on secret-derived data.
Panic sites
Panic symbols in the release binary — each is a potential DoS vector.
Unsafe blocks
Unsafe code count per module. Should trend toward zero.
CT + mutant overlap
Files containing both a TODO(ct) marker and one or more surviving mutants. The TODO(ct) line and survivor lines may differ — the signal is that any CT fix landing in this file would touch code where some mutation already escapes the test suite.
Benchmark blind spots
Hot functions without benchmarks, or benchmarked functions that aren't hot.
Module health
Combined score from coverage, kill rate, CT status, and hot path density.

Coverage?

Line coverage from the test suite, collected with cargo-llvm-cov and nextest. Click a module to see per-file breakdowns, click a file to see source with per-line hit counts.

Heat map
Color intensity shows how hot each line is relative to the file's peak. Amber = inner loops.
Hottest files
Files with the highest peak hit counts — performance-critical code.
CT audit
Hot lines marked TODO(ct) — code on secret data that needs constant-time hardening.
Fragile coverage
Files where every covered line is hit at most twice — thin test coverage.

Benchmarks?

Wall-clock benchmarks via divan. Each operation runs thousands of iterations to measure median time.

Modules
field, bigint, curves, surfaces, quaternions, deuring, sqisign (keygen/sign/verify).
Units
Toggle between ns/μs/ms. Sort by name or time.
Trend
Historical chart when multiple commits are available.

Mutants?

Mutation testing introduces small changes (mutants) to the source and checks if the test suite catches them. Survivors indicate code where tests execute the lines but don't verify correctness.

Kill rate
Percentage of mutants detected. Higher is better.
Caught
Mutants that caused a test failure.
Missed
Mutants that passed all tests — gaps in test quality.
Survivor patterns
Groups survivors by mutation type to reveal categories of untested behavior.
High coverage, low kill rate
Modules where tests execute code but don't verify it — the most misleading coverage.

Awaiting first run.

Constant-Time?

Two complementary constant-time analysis tools:

DudeCT
Statistical t-test. |t| < 4.5 = pass, |t| ≥ 4.5 = timing leak detected.
Tacet
Bayesian attacker-model-aware analysis. Tests against specific adversary capabilities (online, cache, physical) and reports leak probability.
Samples
Number of measurements. More samples = higher confidence for both tools.

Awaiting first run.

Test Vectors?

Compliance with known-answer test vectors and negative/robustness vectors.

KAT
100 vectors from the C reference (pinned commit). Tests sk parsing, pk matching, and C-ref signature verification. (source)
Wycheproof
Negative and robustness vectors in C2SP/wycheproof JSON format. Verification rejects, sk parsing edge cases, and sign-then-verify contract. Not yet upstreamed. (vectors, runner)

Awaiting first run.

Platforms?

Test results across Rust Tier 1 targets. Tests run on native runners for 64-bit targets and cross-compile for 32-bit.

Awaiting first run.

Instructions?

Deterministic instruction-count benchmarks via iai-callgrind (Valgrind). Immune to CI runner noise.

Instructions
Total executed instructions. Deterministic — identical across runs and machines.
L1/L2 misses
Simulated cache misses. High L1 misses on secret data may indicate a cache side-channel.
Branch misses
Mispredicted branches. Data-dependent branches on secrets leak via branch prediction.

Awaiting first run.

Audits?

Automated code health and security checks run on every push.

cargo deny
Dependency advisories and license compliance.
Unsafe
Count of unsafe blocks per module. Should trend toward zero.
Panic count
Panic symbols in the release binary via nm. Each is a potential DoS channel.
Binary size
Release binary text/data/bss segments and top functions by size (cargo-bloat).
Alloc budget
Heap allocation counts for keygen, sign, verify (dhat). Budget assertions fail CI if allocations grow.
Zeroize
Verifies SigningKey memory is zeroed after drop.
Stack depth
Peak stack usage via Valgrind Massif. Tracks signing/verification stack footprint.
API surface
Public API item count by category (cargo-public-api). Tracks API growth.
MSRV
Minimum Supported Rust Version compliance (1.81.0).

Awaiting first run.

Fuzzing?

Coverage-guided fuzzing with cargo-fuzz (libFuzzer). Each target runs for 10 minutes per push, receiving random bytes. Must not panic or crash.

Targets
signature_parse, verifying_key_parse, signing_key_parse, verify
Runs
Total fuzzer executions across all targets.
Crashes
Inputs that caused a panic or crash. Should be zero.
Corpus
Accumulated interesting inputs that increase coverage.
